title: Planar Obliquely Reflected BSVIs on General Filtered Spaces: Non-Symmetric Rotation Fields and Associated Control Problems
summary: We prove existence and uniqueness of a càdlàg solution to a planar backward stochastic variational inequality on a general complete filtered probability space, driven by a square integrable martingale, which may have jumps. The multivalued term is the exterior normal cone operator of a bounded uniformly convex planar domain, and the reflection direction is generated by a time-dependent non-symmetric rotation field.
